primary_source_conclusions: Installed uno.py _uno_struct__setattr__ delegates all assignments to self.__dict__[value]. PyUNO creates exception classes from their UNO base, with root based on Python Exception; each generated class owns __setattr__. ErrorCodeRequest is an exception with ErrCode and no UNO args field; ErrorCodeRequest2 separately owns its setter. Both exact classes therefore need their own listed compatibility closures.
